subject: Cooperative GTM: connector provisioning & co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah@nebulasystems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@nebulasystems.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership: Marketplace connector + co-sell readiness

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — Nebula Systems is excited to move forward with a joint listing and co-sell approach for our data orchestration connector. We ran a quick internal assessment and believe a marketplace listing (Azure + GCP to start, then AWS) plus a co-sell enablement plan would be the fastest path to pilot some of our mutual customers.

Attached are two things to give your integration folks a head start: integration-runbook-v1.pdf (high level flow) and nebula-connector-specs.xlsx (API/auth details). High-level asks from our side: 
- Technical liaison to validate auth and billing SKU mapping
- A mutual action plan (MPA) template for listing + co-sell milestones
- A short pilot window (4–6 weeks) where we can share demo credits and run a joint customer workshop

Can we book a 45-min kickoff next week to align owners and agree on the MPA? Our suggested attendees: me (partners), product lead (Eric Park), and our marketplace eng lead (Maya).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Partner GTM, Nebula Systems
sarah@nebulasystems.com

Attachments: integration-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), nebula-connector-specs.xlsx (XLSX, 90KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@nebulasystems.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Marketplace connector + co-sell readiness

Sarah — thanks for the materials and clear asks. We're keen to move quickly. I looped in Ben (sales lead), Olga (integration engineering), and Grace (partner ops) so we can cover GTM, technical, and listing requirements in the kickoff.

Initial thoughts / proposed agenda for the 45-min call:
1) Introductions & scope (10m)
2) Technical prerequisites (auth, telemetry, private offers) (15m)
3) Mutual action plan milestones and responsibilities (10m)
4) Pilot execution and credit/demo logistics (10m)

Proposed times: Mon Aug 2 10:00–10:45am PT or Tue Aug 3 9:00–9:45am PT. Does either work for your team?

On the technical side Olga, please review the runbook and call out any immediate compatibility or billing SKU questions you see. Grace — we'll need the MPA template and any co-sell checklist you have for Azure/GCP. Ben — we may want to pre-seed a small demo credit allocation for the pilot.

I'll prepare a short MPA draft and share a Drive link ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Alliances — Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah@nebulasystems.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Marketplace connector + co-sell readiness

Karthik / Sarah — I dug into nebula-connector-specs.xlsx and the runbook. A few items we need to lock down before we can scope a Marketplace listing and a co-sell-ready connector: 

1) Auth flow: Is Nebula planning OAuth2 client credential flow (server-to-server) or a user-consent flow? For private offers & single-tenant listing, client credentials are preferred.
2) Telemetry & tracing: We require a minimal set of request-level telemetry (trace id, request latency, error code) for our observability integration. Can you confirm you can emit these as part of connector responses?
3) Billing SKU mapping: For Azure and GCP, we need a mapping table of features -> SKU ids. If you don't have SKU ids yet, we'll work with placeholder SKUs but that will delay private-offer activation.
4) Deployment model: Will the connector be hosted by Nebula (SaaS) or by the customer (self-hosted)? Hosted is simpler for pilot.

Assuming hosted SaaS and client-credentials auth, our rough engineering ask: 2 weeks of integration work + 1 week to validate in a staging listing environment. If that fits your roadmap, we can aim for an initial listing draft in mid-August.

I've attached a trimmed spec export (nebula-connector-specs.xlsx) with a couple of inline comments. Also adding a short checklist I use for marketplace readiness.

Olga Petrov
Senior Integration Engineer — Redwood Inference

To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@nebulasystems.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Marketplace connector + co-sell readiness

Thanks Olga — this is super helpful. Quick clarifications:
- Auth: we'll implement OAuth2 client credentials for the connector (server-to-server).
- Telemetry: we can surface trace-id, latency (ms), and HTTP error codes in response headers; we'll include a lightweight webhook for event-forwarding if you prefer.
- Billing SKUs: we don't have final SKU ids yet; attached MPA draft includes tentative feature->placeholder SKU rows.
- Deployment: hosted SaaS (we will host).

We agree with your two-week integration estimate. I'll book the Mon Aug 2 slot you suggested at 10:00am PT — confirmed for our side (Eric and Maya will join). I've also uploaded a mutual-action-plan-draft.docx to the Drive and shared the DocuSign link for a preliminary MPA signature: https://www.docusign.com/en/doc/NB-2026-07.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Sarah

Sarah — great to meet you on the kickoff earlier. Quick follow-ups and commitments from our side: 

- Demo credits: we'll pre-allocate a $2k demo credit pool for the 4-week pilot; ops will issue codes after the MPA signature.
- Sales enablement: I'll create a short battlecard + a one-pager for our field reps and share by Aug 10.
- Marketplace listing: Grace will own the listing checklist and will coordinate with your marketplace eng lead to collect any missing artifacts (screenshots, compliance statements).

Next steps (agreed on call):
1) Sarah: finalize MPA draft and send DocuSign for signature (you mentioned the link).
2) Olga: complete integration validation in staging by Aug 14.
3) Grace: initiate listing intake and send required artifact checklist by Aug 6.
4) Ben: deliver sales battlecard by Aug 10.

I'll follow up in HubSpot (DEAL-98765) and tag the ticket so our AE can track pipeline crediting. Thanks all — excited for this partnership.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
